review.notes: Triage review of the 109-page report within a fixed time budget. Structure: whole OCR markdown scanned programmatically - all 20 code-fence pairs are balanced, no fence swallows headings/tables/images, no duplicated title lines, and no speaker-label or figure-banner headings (the 'Weak/Strong model excerpt' labels in Appendix C are printed text in the PDF, not figure-internal). Droppage: automated normalized 5-gram containment of every PDF page's text against the OCR markdown flagged 40 low-hit pages; each flagged page was inspected - flags resolved into figure-internal vector text (axis labels/legends on pp. 5, 16, 18-24, 29-33, 37-38, 47-50, 53-58, 88, 98-99, 102, 105, 108), LaTeX-equivalent equation wording (pp. 7-10, 31-36, 39, 44-45, 102), intact HTML tables (pp. 10, 20-21, 23, 47, 53-54, 98-99, 102, 105), and the genuine drops patched below. Pages 1, 9, 23, 43, 47, 48, 59, 89, 95, 100, 104 were additionally rendered and visually checked line-by-line; the remaining pages were machine-scanned only. All inserted footnote strings were extracted byte-exact from the PDF text layer and checked against renders; the fn9 space after the ≥ sign was confirmed at 300 dpi. Punctuation spacing after inline math is repaired by the shared OCR normalizer rather than document patches.
